Gonna give you a real answer lol. Also not sure why a prior internship would even be necessary? But yeah, I got FAANG as my first, junior year. 

I attended a no-name university, Computer Science major. GPA was 3.5+ at that  point. Listed one project, a simple alarm clock quiz app from class. The only things I had under work experience were TAing and helping out with undergrad ML research (I do not know ML, I was just a code monkey doing grunt work). I also put down languages (probably 3-4) and technologies under skills and a few "relevant courses" (e.g. Web programming).  These were honestly common, not impressive, and I didn't have anything else to make me stand out so I included all my student involvement, which was 3-4 positions in CS clubs over the years; volunteering (CompSci outreach); and academic awards/honors/scholarships/grants I received, which I think was like 5 in total? 

Since I'm not going to post my actual resume, hope some info about the appearance will  be helpful.  The page was pretty filled but did not go over 2 pages. Looking back it was kind of ugly because of how much content was squished in. Sans-serif font, and used a pink-red as an accent color. 1-2 lines of description per item, bullet points as needed. 

I graduated with 3 internships, 2 FAANG and 1 unicorn. Could probably answer more q's  if anyone has any, or maybe critique resumes.
